effects.summary: Surrounds the target in a shell of fresh air.
effects.immunity: Target is immune to harmful vapors and gases.
effects.effect: Target can survive in an environment without air for 1 week.
Target is protected from deep underwater pressure.
Target is protected from the vacuum of space.

interactions.rule: Used to create necklaces of adaptation.

targets.rule: New form must be another humanoid creature.

effects.summary: Allows the caster to assume the shape of another humanoid creature.
effects.effect: Caster may control height, weight, gender, hair color, hair texture, and skin color within the normal ranges for the adopted kind.
Equipment remains worn or held where possible; otherwise it melds into the new form.

interactions.rule: When combined with a successful Disguise proficiency throw, the caster can appear as a specific individual.

effects.summary: Creates an auditory illusion of choir music.
effects.effect: Sound volume can range from a soloist to a chorus of 64 singers.
Music can originate from any point within range.
Melody, harmony, and volume are controlled by the caster.
Lyrics cannot be precisely deciphered regardless of language.

duration_rules.rule: The effect can continue for up to 6 turns.
The effect ends immediately if the caster attacks or is attacked.

spell.name: Burning Hands
spell.area: 40' long cone, 20' wide, extending from the caster's hands

effects.summary: Produces a cone of searing flame.

saving_throw.partial: Successful save reduces damage to half.

scaling.rule: Damage increases by 1d4 per caster level to a maximum of 5d4.

effects.summary: Calls a dragon into the caster's service.
effects.effect: The summoned dragon is always Old age category.
The summoned dragon has 14 Hit Dice.
The summoned dragon has 1 draconic special ability.
The dragon's hide color and breath weapon match the terrain in which it is summoned.
The dragon serves and obeys the summoner until duration ends, it is slain, or it is dispelled.

limits.limit: May be performed safely only once per week.

entry.condition: spell recast before one week has passed

duration_rules.entry: The summoned dragon is hostile and immediately attacks the caster.

targets.requirement: A storm must be within range.
targets.valid_target: all creatures within the strike area

effects.summary: Allows the caster to call lightning bolts from a nearby storm.
effects.damage: Each bolt deals 8d6 damage to all creatures within the area of effect.

saving_throw.partial: Successful save reduces damage to half.

procedure.step: Confirm that a storm is within range.
Choose a point within range.
Resolve one lightning bolt striking a 20' diameter area.
Repeat at most once per turn while the spell remains active.

duration_rules.rule: The caster is not required to call lightning every turn.
Unused bolts remain available until the spell ends or the storm ends.

effects.summary: Allows the target to blend into surroundings almost to invisibility.
effects.bonus: +8 bonus to proficiency throws to hide in shadows.
effects.effect: The affected character can always hide in shadows on a throw of at least 12+.

interactions.rule: Used to create elven cloaks.

effects.summary: Identical to the 4th level arcane spell of the same name except for classification.
Identical to the 1st level arcane spell of the same name except for classification.
Creates a visual and auditory illusion of an object, creature, or force.
effects.effect: The illusion lacks smell, texture, and temperature.
The caster may move the image within the limits of the effect's size.
Illusory creatures have Armor Class 0 and disappear if hit in combat.
If the illusion simulates an attack spell or attacking creature, its apparent damage matches the normal damage of the simulated attack form.
Illusory damage is not real.

saving_throw.partial: Successful save avoids all illusory damage.

duration_rules.rule: The image persists while the caster concentrates and for 2 additional rounds after concentration ends.

entry.condition: victim was apparently killed or injured by illusory damage

duration_rules.entry: Victim realizes after 1d4 rounds that no real harm was caused by this spell.

effects.summary: Creates an invisible grip around the target's throat.
effects.condition_effect: On a failed save, the target begins choking.
effects.damage: While choking, the target takes 1d6 damage per round.
effects.condition_effect: While choking, the target cannot take any action but can still defend itself.

saving_throw.rule: The target receives a new saving throw each round.

duration_rules.rule: The effect lasts while the caster concentrates.
The effect ends when the target succeeds on a saving throw.

targets.valid_target: a living creature in the chosen area
targets.requirement: The caster must specify direction and approximate distance up to 60' away.
targets.rule: The target area need not be in line of sight.

effects.summary: Allows the caster to hear sounds in another area through a living creature in that area.
effects.effect: The target creature is unaware of being used in this way.

limits.limit: If there is no appropriate creature in the chosen area, the spell fails.

interactions.rule: A lead barrier between caster and subject blocks the effect.
Used to create potions of clairaudience.

duration_rules.rule: The caster may choose another subject creature after at least 1 turn has passed.
If the subject moves out of range, contact is lost, though the caster may be able to choose another target.

effects.summary: Identical to the 3rd level arcane spell of the same name except for classification.

targets.rule: Animals totaling 6 Hit Dice can be commanded.

effects.summary: Commands animals within range.
effects.effect: Commanded animals respond to the caster's will and do whatever is commanded.
effects.penalty: After control ends, reaction rolls with the animals suffer a -1 penalty.

saving_throw.rule: Unintelligent animals receive no saving throw.

duration_rules.rule: The effect lasts while concentration is maintained.
The caster can take no other actions while concentrating.
duration_rules.entry: Animals are not well disposed to the spellcaster.

interactions.rule: Used to create rings of animal command.

targets.rule: Up to 6 Hit Dice of humans can be commanded.
0-level humans count as 1/2 Hit Die for this calculation.

effects.summary: Commands people within range.
effects.effect: Commanded creatures respond to the caster's will and do whatever is commanded.
effects.penalty: After control ends, reaction rolls with the commanded creatures suffer a -1 penalty.

duration_rules.rule: The effect lasts while concentration is maintained.
The caster can take no other actions while concentrating.
duration_rules.entry: Commanded creatures are not well disposed to the spellcaster.

interactions.rule: Used to create rings of human command.

effects.summary: Commands plants and plant-like creatures.
effects.effect: Controlled plants obey the caster's will.
The spell can make normally immobile plants move.

saving_throw.rule: Unintelligent plants receive no saving throw.

duration_rules.rule: The effect lasts while concentration is maintained.
The caster can take no other actions while concentrating.
duration_rules.entry: Intelligent plants are hostile to the spellcaster.

interactions.rule: Used to create rings of plant command.

spell.name: Cone of Cold
spell.area: 60' long cone, 30' wide, extending from the caster's hands

effects.summary: Produces a chilling cone.

saving_throw.partial: Successful save reduces damage to half.

scaling.rule: Damage increases by 1d6 per caster level.

interactions.rule: Used to create wands of cold.

spell.name: Cone of Paralysis
spell.area: 60' long cone, 30' wide, extending from the caster's hands

effects.summary: Produces a cone of paralysis.
effects.condition_effect: Creatures that fail their save are paralyzed for 6 turns.

interactions.rule: Used to create wands of paralysis.

targets.option: Any combination of gelatinous cubes, gray oozes, green slimes, ochre jellies, or similar oozes.
targets.requirement: Each ooze must be 6 HD or less and have one or fewer special abilities.

effects.summary: Conjures oozes from a primordial sphere of existence.
effects.effect: Conjured oozes appear anywhere within range.
While controlled, the oozes respond to the caster's will and do whatever is commanded.

duration_rules.rule: The effect lasts while concentration is maintained.
duration_rules.entry: Control is lost permanently and cannot be regained.
The oozes attack the caster and all others in their path.
duration_rules.rule: The caster may dismiss controlled oozes at will, acting on the caster's Initiative if in combat.
In no case do the oozes remain longer than 1 turn per caster level.

interactions.rule: Once control is lost, only dispel magic or dispel evil dismisses the oozes.

targets.invalid_target: fantastic creatures such as griffons or wyverns
targets.rule: Controls up to 3d6 Hit Dice of animals.
The caster may choose which creatures in a mixed group are affected first.
Excess Hit Dice of effect are ignored.
At least one creature is always affected.

effects.summary: Controls animals as if using charm monster.

saving_throw.rule: Unintelligent animals receive no saving throw.

duration_rules.entry: The animals are afraid and leave the area if they can.

interactions.rule: Functions as charm monster for affected targets.
Used to create potions of animal control.

spell.name: Control Plants
spell.area: 30' x 30' area to a range of 60'

targets.valid_target: plant-like creatures, including fungi and molds

effects.summary: Controls plants or plant-like creatures.
effects.effect: Controlled plants obey the caster's will.
The spell can make normally immobile plants move.
Examples of movement include twisting, writhing, and wrapping around targets in the area.
Intelligent plant-like creatures can be given orders subject to the normal limitations of charm effects.

saving_throw.rule: Unintelligent plants receive no saving throw.

interactions.rule: Subject to the normal limitations of charm effects.
Used to create potions of plant control.

targets.rule: Controls up to 3d6 Hit Dice of undead of 4 HD or fewer, or one undead creature of more than 4 HD.

effects.summary: Controls undead despite their normal immunity to charm effects.
effects.effect: Unintelligent undead are completely under the caster's control and obey entirely.
Intelligent undead can be given orders subject to the normal limitations of charm monster.

saving_throw.rule: Unintelligent undead receive no saving throw.

interactions.rule: Overrides undead immunity to charm effects for this spell.
Used to create potions of undead control.

effects.summary: Manipulates airflow within range.
effects.effect: The caster can reduce air to dead calm, create a gentle breeze, or whip the wind up to gale force.

procedure.step: Choose the desired wind condition within range.
To change wind completely from calm to gale or vice versa, concentrate for 1 full turn.

limits.limit: While concentrating to fully change the wind, the caster cannot move or attack.

interactions.rule: If two spellcasters both use control wind, the higher-level spellcaster gains control after 1 turn.
At sea, the spell can increase or decrease ship speed depending on whether the ship sails with or against the wind.

special.rule: At gale force, flying creatures are grounded.
At gale force, creatures on the ground have movement reduced by half.
At gale force, missile weapon use becomes impossible.
In sandy or dusty terrain, gale force winds reduce visibility to 20'.

effects.summary: Functions like cure light wounds with greater healing.
effects.healing: Heals 4d6 points of damage plus 1 point per caster level.

effects.summary: Functions like cause light wounds with greater damage.
effects.damage: Inflicts 4d6 points of damage plus 1 point per caster level.

effects.summary: Functions like cure light wounds with greater healing.
effects.healing: Heals 2d6 points of damage plus 1 point per 2 caster levels.

effects.summary: Functions like cause light wounds with greater damage.
effects.damage: Inflicts 2d6 points of damage plus 1 point per 2 caster levels.

effects.summary: Functions like cure light wounds with greater healing.
Functions like cause light wounds with greater damage.
Transforms targets into pigs for the duration.
effects.effect: Failed targets gain the form, physical characteristics, and mental characteristics of pigs.
The transformation is total, including intelligence, behavioral traits, and mentality.
Failed targets do not remember their former life while transformed and behave as pigs.
Transformed targets retain the same number of hit points they had before transformation.

interactions.rule: Creatures with shape changing abilities, such as dopplegangers, can return to their natural form in 1 round.

effects.summary: Protects the target from death-related magic.
effects.immunity: Target is immune to any curse spells or effects.
Target is immune to any death spells or effects.

interactions.rule: Used to create scarabs of protection.

targets.valid_target: the bones or body of a single dead creature
targets.requirement: A skeleton requires mostly intact skeletal remains.
A zombie requires a mostly intact corpse.

effects.summary: Animates one dead creature as a temporary skeleton or zombie under spoken command.
effects.effect: The caster must touch the remains.
The undead follows the caster's spoken commands.
Skeletons have Hit Dice equal to the creature's Hit Dice in life.
Human and demi-human skeletons always have 1 Hit Die regardless of character level in life.
Zombies have one more Hit Die than the creature had in life.

limits.limit: Unlike animate dead, the created undead's Hit Dice are not limited by caster level.

duration_rules.rule: After 1 turn, the undead crumbles to dust.

effects.summary: Temporarily halts the progress of disease.
effects.effect: Affects acute, chronic, infectious, necrotic, lycanthropic, and rotting diseases listed in the source.
Temporarily halts incubation of diseases that are not yet symptomatic.
Temporarily ameliorates symptoms of existing disease.

limits.limit: Does not reverse damage already caused by disease.

entry.condition: the disease is not cured before the spell ends

duration_rules.entry: Disease progression resumes when the duration ends.

targets.valid_target: creatures within 30' that are subject to a charm or similar effect

effects.summary: Reveals creatures affected by charm-like magic.
effects.effect: Charmed creatures glow with a pale blue light visible to the caster.
The spell reveals only that a creature is charmed, not the nature of the charm.

procedure.step: Identify creatures within 30' subject to charm or similar effects.
If the caster concentrates on one creature for 1 turn, roll for exact identification.

special.rule: Examples of detectable effects include command and control potions, rings, spells, and innate charms such as those of harpies or vampires.

scaling.rule: After 1 turn of concentration on a creature, the caster has a 5% chance per level to determine the exact nature of the charm.

effects.summary: Masks all charms on one creature.
effects.effect: Completely masks any and all charms on a single creature for 24 hours.

interactions.rule: Detect magic still reveals that the subject is under a spell effect.

special.rule: Undetectable charm is not on the Priestess spell list and is included for Judge use in custom classes.

effects.summary: Reveals cursed items and areas.
effects.effect: Cursed items and areas glow with a pale blue light visible to the caster.
The spell reveals only that an item or area is cursed, not the nature of the curse or its trigger.

procedure.step: Identify cursed items and areas within 30'.
If the caster concentrates on one item or area for 1 turn, roll for exact identification.

scaling.rule: After 1 turn of concentration on an item or area, the caster has a 5% chance per level to determine the exact nature of the curse.

effects.summary: Masks all curses on one item or area.
effects.effect: Completely masks any and all curses on a single item or area for 24 hours.

interactions.rule: Detect magic still reveals that the item or area is under a spell effect.

targets.valid_target: object such as a chest, weapon, or smaller item

effects.summary: Determines whether the examined target is dangerous.
effects.effect: Reveals whether the target is a clear and present danger, a potential danger, or no danger.
Does not reveal the precise nature of the danger.

procedure.step: Concentrate for 1 full round on one small area, creature, or object.
For larger areas, creatures, or objects, spend proportionally more time.
Learn the target's danger category.

special.rule: Most creatures register as potential dangers.
Most poisons register as clear and present dangers.

effects.summary: Identical to the 2nd level arcane spell of the same name except for classification.
Reveals poisoned or poisonous targets.
effects.effect: Poisoned or poisonous targets are seen by the caster with a glowing greenish-yellow aura.

limits.limit: The aura cannot be seen by anyone else.

effects.summary: Detects ritual spellcasting within range.
effects.effect: If one or more ritual spells are detected, the caster senses the direction and approximate range to the rituals.
If one or more ritual spells are detected, the caster senses the spell signature of the rituals' casters.

limits.limit: May be performed only once per week.

scaling.rule: Range increases by 100 miles per caster level.

effects.summary: Detects secret doors within range.
effects.effect: The caster sees secret doors with a blue glowing aura.

limits.limit: The aura cannot be seen by anyone else.

effects.summary: Detects undead.
effects.effect: If undead are within line of sight, the caster sees them surrounded by a sickly grey-green aura.
More powerful undead have thicker auras.
Invisible undead become visible to the caster through the aura.
If undead are not within line of sight, the caster still becomes aware of their proximity, number, and relative power.

special.rule: The descriptive text states detection within 60' even though the spell's range line is 30'.

effects.summary: Maims and dismembers the target.
effects.damage: On a failed save, the target takes 3d6 damage.
effects.effect: On a failed save, the target immediately rolls on the Mortal Wounds table and applies the Permanent Wounds Suffered result.

saving_throw.negates: Successful save avoids the spell's effect.

procedure.step: Target attempts a saving throw versus Death.
If the save fails, apply 3d6 damage.
Immediately roll on the Mortal Wounds table.
Apply only the result under Permanent Wounds Suffered.

interactions.rule: The Condition & Recovery column of the Mortal Wounds table is ignored for this spell.

special.rule: When rolling on the Mortal Wounds table because of dismember, only the target's CON modifier applies.

effects.summary: Grants a saving throw bonus.

entry.condition: recipient acts contrary to the divine caster's alignment or deity

targets.rule: Targets up to one creature per caster level.
All targets must be within the area of effect.
The caster chooses which creatures in the area are targeted.

effects.summary: Pillars of jagged rock erupt and impale selected targets.
effects.damage: Each successfully struck target takes 5d6 damage.
effects.effect: The pillars crumble to dust immediately after damage is dealt.

procedure.step: Choose up to one target per caster level within a 30' diameter area.
Make an attack throw against each chosen target using the target values for a fighter of the caster's level.
Deal 5d6 damage to each target successfully hit.

scaling.rule: Target count increases to one creature per caster level.

targets.valid_target: small container holding 6 stone or less

effects.summary: Creates a nondimensional storage space inside a small container.
effects.effect: The interior can hold objects totaling up to 10' x 5' x 3' in volume and 100 stone (1,000 lb) in weight.
The container weighs at most 6 stone regardless of contents.
Living creatures can be kept safely in the space.

duration_rules.rule: The nondimensional space remains intact for 60 days.
duration_rules.entry: There is a cumulative 5% chance per day that the space collapses.

limits.limit: Living things inside must still eat, sleep, and age normally.
Living things inside die if they run out of food, air, water, or similar necessities.

interactions.rule: The space collapses if the enchanted container is dispelled.
The space collapses if one enchanted container is placed within another.
If the space collapses, all stored contents violently erupt out of the container.
If the space collapses, fragile objects such as potions, scrolls, and jewelry are destroyed.
If living creatures are inside when the space collapses, they take 1d6 damage per 10 stone of objects stored in the container.
Used to create bags of holding.

effects.summary: Strikes the target with negative energy.
effects.effect: On a failed save, the target loses one Hit Die or life level.
A creature with only 1 HD or less affected by enervate is instantly slain.
Creatures that survive recover the lost Hit Die or life level with no permanent harm when the duration expires.

effects.summary: Totally enslaves the target to the caster's will until dispelled.
effects.effect: When the caster is present, the enslaved creature obeys orders completely.
If direct communication is impossible, the enslaved creature still acts in the caster's interest to serve and protect the caster as best it can.
The enslaved creature does not defend itself or take arms against the caster even if the caster attacks it or its friends.
When the caster is absent, the enslaved creature is confused and passive.
When the caster is absent, the enslaved creature can carry out routine activities but cannot use spells, use magic items, or make complex decisions.

saving_throw.condition: Targets with 2 HD or more may save.
saving_throw.rule: Targets with less than 2 HD receive no save.

interactions.rule: The effect ends if dispelled.
Characters familiar with the target can tell that something is wrong, though they may not know it is enslaved unless they detect charm.

targets.requirement: The caster must have an appropriate Performance proficiency.

effects.summary: Captures attention and holds listeners spellbound while the caster performs.
effects.effect: Affected creatures give the caster undivided attention and ignore their surroundings.
Affected creatures are treated as Friendly while enthralled.
Affected creatures take no action while the performance continues and for 1d3 rounds thereafter while discussing it.
Creatures entering the area during the performance can also become enthralled.

saving_throw.rule: Creatures Hostile to the caster when the performance begins gain a +4 bonus to their save.

procedure.step: The caster performs continuously for 1 full round by dancing, playing, speaking, singing, or similar performance.
After the first round, creatures within 60' attempt a save versus Paralysis.
Creatures that fail become enthralled.
Creatures entering the area during the performance also save or become enthralled.

duration_rules.rule: The spell lasts while the caster performs, up to a maximum of 1 hour.

entry.condition: affected monster has 4 or more HD or affected character has WIS 16 or higher

duration_rules.entry: The creature remains aware of its surroundings and counts as Indifferent rather than Friendly.
One heckling attempt is allowed per use of the spell; the caster needs a successful Performance proficiency throw to ignore it.

entry.condition: the caster is physically or magically attacked and performance is interrupted

duration_rules.entry: All affected creatures rush to the caster's defense for 1d3 rounds.

entry.condition: any affected creature is attacked or threatened by the caster or the caster's party

special.rule: If the spell ends because an affected creature is attacked or threatened by the caster or party, Friendly creatures become Unfriendly and Indifferent creatures become Hostile.

effects.summary: Identical to the 2nd level arcane spell of the same name except for classification.
Greatly increases the target's visual range.
effects.effect: The target can see 100 times further than normal.
effects.bonus: Missile attack penalty at medium range becomes -1.
Missile attack penalty at long range becomes -2.

interactions.rule: Used to create the magic item of the same name.
